items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And then I remember, another great band was -- in later years, well, around '28, around in there, '29,'30, Sammy Stewart. He had a terrific band...

ctx.x: You were talking about Erskine Tate.

Yeah, well, I talked about Erskine -- I never -- see, he was a little before my time. He started in the '20s, he was in the '20s, and he had that great band at the Vendome Theatre. And it was just a rare treat to go -- the people used to go, not for the movie, not for whatever, they went to hear that band.

And in the band, he had greats like Earl Hines and at one time, Teddy Weatherford on piano. He featured all these people -- Louis Armstrong and Jimmy Bertran and Bud Scott worked there, all these different…
Well, did he just conduct -- well, Tate just conducted then.
